role: @Observable holder of streaming-mode and pause/resume state split out of RRCollector so views observing it do not re-render on unrelated collector changes, and of the one-caller claim on ending an overnight session; injected into the SwiftUI environment and read by Record views.
types: StreamingLifecycle.OvernightEndingClaim: struct (Equatable) — one numbered claim on ending the overnight session
toplevel: Seven observable stored properties with default initialisers, plus overnightEndingClaim (private(set)) and the claim counter, changed only through claimOvernightEnding / releaseOvernightEnding(_:) / dropStaleOvernightEnding by the overnight Stop, Pause and Discard and a starting night. Owned by RRCollector (RRCollector.swift:187, created at 703) and read through @Environment(StreamingLifecycle.self) in RecordView and passed to StreamingLiveView/RecordingStatusViews/RecordPanels.

units.does: True while an ending claim is held (overnightEndingClaim non-nil).

Claims the ending of the overnight session for the caller: nil when no night is streaming or a claim is already held; otherwise issues a new numbered OvernightEndingClaim, holds it in overnightEndingClaim and returns it.

branches.cond: not overnight streaming, or a claim already held

units.does: Ends a claimed ending: clears overnightEndingClaim only when the given claim is the one held; a claim already released or dropped changes nothing.

branches.cond: the given claim is not the one held

units.does: For a night that is starting: clears any held claim and returns whether one was held.
